title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Watermelon Strawberry Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Watermelon Strawberry Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod brings together two bright fruits for a refreshing all-day vape. Sweet Watermelon provides a smooth tropical base, while ripe Strawberry adds a juicy lift for a flavour that’s light, balanced, and moreish. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod during use. Together they deliver up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, with no need for messy refills or coil changes. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod delivers smooth vapour and clear flavour from start to finish. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to go.
